title: PlannerError
description: The `error` payload of a `backlog-planner` failure envelope (`{"error": ...}`), built in `youtrack/planner/src/backlog_planner/api.py`'s `_planner_error`/`_bad_body` handlers from `youtrack/planner/src/backlog_planner/domain/errors.py`. `code` is deliberately a plain string, not a closed enum -- the documented values below are what ships today, but a new code must never become a breaking schema change for an older consumer.

code.description: One of the documented codes below, or a future addition. | Code | Status | | --- | --- | | `invalid_request` | 422 | | `unknown_model` | 422 | | `project_not_found` | 404 | | `plan_not_found` | 404 | | `project_key_taken` | 409 | | `plan_already_confirmed` | 409 | | `confirmed_plan_fixed` | 409 | | `confirm_in_progress` | 409 | | `project_changed` | 409, with `details` | | `field_conflict` | 409 | | `ai_blocked` | 402 (Treasury, D023) | `plan_invalid` | 502, with `details` | | `ai_skipped` | 502 | `tracker_rejected` | 502 | | `tracker_auth_rejected` | 502 | `ai_unavailable` | 503 | | `tracker_unavailable` | 503 | `tracker_not_configured` | 503 |

details.description: Present on `project_changed` and `plan_invalid`, and on a `422 invalid_request` raised from request-body validation.
